user.title: Connect to Pilot runtime
user.description: Enter the address of the Pilot add-on or a remote Pilot instance.

hassio_confirm.title: Pilot add-on discovered
hassio_confirm.description: The Pilot add-on was discovered on this system. Confirm to add it.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Pilot runtime. Check host, port and token.

confirm.title: Pilot runtime unreachable
confirm.description: Home Assistant cannot reach the Pilot runtime. The add-on may be stopped, or the configured host/port is wrong. Home automation keeps working; only Pilot features are paused. This issue clears itself once the runtime is back.

abort.resolved_when_runtime_back: This issue clears itself once the Pilot runtime is reachable again.

confirm.title: Core migration not confirmed
confirm.description: The Pilot add-on jumped to a new core version and the migration health check has not confirmed it yet (target version: {target}). The data snapshot from before the migration: {snapshot}. Open the Pilot workshop (Admin) and check the runtime state before the next restart.

abort.resolved_when_migration_done: This issue clears itself once the migration gate confirms the new core version.

ask.name: Ask Pilot
ask.description: Ask the Pilot agent a question; the answer is fired as a pilot_ask_answered event.

propose.name: Propose to the owner
propose.description: Put a proposal into the Pilot trust queue; the owner confirms or declines in the workshop.

title.name: Title
title.description: Proposal title shown in the queue.
